meta.description: How Frankencoin (ZCHF) differs from issuer-backed Swiss franc stablecoins and from USDC: backing, issuer, savings rate and control.

hero.title: How ZCHF differs.
hero.subtitle: Not every Swiss franc stablecoin works the same way. The main difference is whether a company issues it against bank deposits, or a protocol issues it against on-chain collateral.
